title: Cloud Marketplace listing refresh — umbrella project plan (AWS + GCP)
creator: Chris Osei
dependencies: PM-1847 (security docs gap analysis + publish plan alignment)
ENG-22111 (metering dimension mapping must be correct before submission)
ENG-22116 (entitlement sync reliability hardening before launch)
description:
Objective
Refresh Redwood Inference’s AWS and GCP Cloud Marketplace presence to support enterprise procurement paths and reduce onboarding friction for marketplace-driven customers.

This umbrella issue owns the end-to-end project plan: scope definition, milestones, cross-functional workstreams, submission coordination, and go/no-go readiness. Individual deliverables are tracked in the linked sub-issues.

Goals (what success looks like)
1) Listing modernization: Replace legacy listings with current positioning (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), up-to-date screenshots, and buyer-friendly FAQs.
2) Packaging: New Marketplace SKUs aligned to internal billing meters and enterprise buying patterns (usage-based Hosted, reserved capacity for Dedicated, licensing/support for Private, plus compliance/observability add-ons).
3) Security packet: Marketplace-ready security documentation bundle suitable for AWS/GCP security review and accelerates customer questionnaires.
4) Onboarding: Reduce time-to-first-success from marketplace subscription → entitlement → org provisioning → first API key → first successful request. Handle edge cases (existing org, multi-subscription, entitlement propagation delays).

Non-goals (explicitly out of scope for this phase)
- Re-architecting core billing pipeline beyond adding new dimensions/IDs needed for Marketplace mapping.
- Major redesign of console onboarding unrelated to marketplace entrypoint (keep changes focused on entitlement + provisioning UX).
- Rewriting general product docs; only marketplace-facing pages + necessary redirects.

Workstreams + owners
A) Packaging / SKUs / offers
- DRI: Soojin Lee (PMM) + Chris Osei (PM program)
- Contributors: Lauren Bishop (Dedicated SKU fit), Vivek Kulkarni (Private SKU fit), Cole Summers (billing hooks), Laura Bennett / Emily Stone (finance), Michael Grant / Sofia Mendes (legal)
- Outputs: SKU catalog v2, internal-to-marketplace mapping, pricing guardrails, private offer template notes, revrec + invoicing notes.

B) Marketplace listing assets (AWS + GCP)
- DRI: Camila Reyes (Marketing) + Stephanie Nguyen (Partnerships/GTM)
- Contributors: Alicia Perez (visuals), Ben Carter (growth/onboarding funnel), Elliot Price / Alex Martinez (Docs)
- Outputs: final copy blocks, required screenshots/diagrams, FAQs, support SLA statements, “How it works” onboarding sections.

C) Security documentation packet
- DRI: Naomi Feldman (Security/Compliance PO)
- Contributors: Dr. Aisha Rahman (exec sponsor), Olga Petrov (GRC/evidence), Marcus Lin (security eng), Docs (Alex Martinez)
- Outputs: security overview, shared responsibility, data flow diagram references, encryption/KMS posture, audit logs, retention/residency, evidence pointers + what is public vs gated.

D) Engineering enablement (entitlement, metering, onboarding UX, telemetry)
- DRI: Priya Natarajan (Eng sponsor)
- Contributors: Ethan Park (control plane), Chloe Martin (console onboarding), Nadia Rahman (telemetry), Leila Farouk (QA)
- Outputs: entitlement verification API, metering dimension mapping, console marketplace entrypoint + error states, multi-subscription edge cases, entitlement sync hardening, funnel telemetry.

Deliverables (must ship)
1) New AWS Marketplace listing + offer structure aligned with SKU catalog v2
2) New GCP Marketplace listing + billing dimensions aligned with SKU catalog v2
3) Marketplace onboarding docs (AWS + GCP guides, troubleshooting, FAQs) + required docs-site redirects/vanity URLs
4) Marketplace security documentation pack (public/gated split finalized and consistent across listing + docs)
5) Engineering changes needed for entitlements + metering + onboarding UX + telemetry
6) Internal enablement: procurement one-pager updates, RevOps deal ops notes, support macros/escalation path

Milestones / timeline (target: 6–8 weeks)
Phase 1 — Discovery + requirements (Week 1–2)
- Confirm SKU gaps + Marketplace constraints (AWS/GCP)
- Security checklist: required artifacts + publishability decisions
- Instrumentation plan: baseline funnel metrics + target deltas
Exit criteria: PRD confirmed; SKU requirements draft approved; security doc gap checklist created.

Phase 2 — Draft assets + SKU mapping + security packet (Week 2–4)
- Copy drafts for AWS + GCP
- Screenshots/diagram capture plan finalized
- SKU mapping: internal meters ↔ marketplace dimensions validated in staging
- Security packet draft reviewed (Security + Legal) with accurate claims
Exit criteria: cross-functional review sign-off to proceed to implementation + partner pre-review.

Phase 3 — Implement onboarding/metering changes + docs updates (Week 3–6)
- Entitlement verification endpoints + console entrypoint
- Metering dimension mapping fix + reconciliation notes
- Entitlement sync reliability hardening (retries/idempotency/alerting)
- Docs published + redirects in place
Exit criteria: E2E onboarding passes in staging for AWS + GCP; telemetry events flowing.

Phase 4 — Submission + review iterations + launch readiness (Week 5–8)
- Submit AWS + GCP packages
- Iterate on partner feedback (wording/artifacts)
- Enablement + internal comms
- Launch + monitor funnel + support load
Exit criteria: partner approval received; go/no-go met; launch brief approved.

Go/No-Go criteria (minimum bar)
- Marketplace onboarding success path works for net-new org and existing org linking (AWS + GCP).
- Entitlement sync job meets reliability targets (no sustained backlog; alerting in place).
- Metering dimensions verified against SKU catalog (no mismatches like SUP-4829 scenario).
- Security packet published/available per publication plan; claims consistent across docs + listing.
- Support escalation path + macros live; SE/CS enablement shared.

Success metrics (track weekly post-launch)
- Conversion: marketplace listing → subscription rate (AWS + GCP)
- Onboarding: median time-to-first-token (subscription → first successful request)
- Drop-off rate at entitlement validation / org provisioning steps
- Support: volume of marketplace provisioning delay escalations (e.g., SUP-4821 class)
- Billing: number of dimension mismatch incidents; reconciliation exceptions

Risks + mitigations
- Approval cycles: AWS/GCP review timelines can slip.
  Mitigation: pre-review with partners; keep artifacts checklist current; submit early with “final copy pending” only where allowed.
- SKU change compatibility: avoid breaking existing customers / legacy listing migration.
  Mitigation: explicit mapping plan; ensure old SKUs remain valid during transition; comms + internal playbook.
- Security statements accuracy: risk of over-claiming on encryption/retention/audit logs.
  Mitigation: Security/GRC approval required; maintain a single source of truth doc and reuse exact approved copy blocks.
- Entitlement propagation delays cause poor buyer experience.
  Mitigation: console UX guidance + retries; sync job hardening + alerting; support runbook.

Open questions
1) Final public vs gated split for evidence links (SOC2 bridge letters, pen test summary, etc.) — needs Security/GRC + Legal sign-off.
2) How we handle legacy customers subscribed via old listing when new SKUs go live (grandfathering vs migration path).
3) Private offer guardrails (minimums, discount approvals) and how they map to console limits/quotas.
4) Region/residency statements in listings (ensure consistent with actual supported regions + contractual language).
